inputs.share_count_basis: Q2 2026 6-K weighted average DILUTED shares 4,062m (basic 4,014m + 48m dilutive awards), after completion of the GBP2bn buyback in Q2 2026. Expressed in ADS-equivalents (1 ADS = 2 ordinary shares): 4,062 / 2 = 2,031.0m, so every per-share value is per ADS. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would double-charge it. No non-SBC issuance is expected (Nuvalent and RAPT were cash/debt funded).
inputs.net_debt_basis: GSK-defined net debt at 30 June 2026 of GBP15,132m (cash 3,105 + liquid investments 1 less short-term borrowings 4,291 and long-term borrowings 13,947; GSK borrowings include IFRS-16 lease liabilities) PLUS the Nuvalent acquisition, which closed 15 July 2026 for GBP7.1bn net of cash acquired (GBP8.0bn equity value), funded from new and existing debt plus cash (Q2 2026 6-K post-balance-sheet note). Pro forma net debt 15,132 + 7,100 = 22,232. total_debt = 4,291 + 13,947 + 7,100 = 25,338; cash = 3,106. Q3 2026 operating cash generation and the Q3 dividend are not yet reported and are not anticipated.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F consolidated cash flow statement share-based payment add-back, GBP374m (CSV StockBasedComp). GSK settles awards from ESOP-trust and treasury shares; there is no separately disclosed net-share-settlement tax withholding line, so sbc_incl_equity_taxes = sbc. Interest income (GBP169m FY2025) is NOT stripped: GSK is in net debt, so there is no cash pile counted twice.
inputs.buyback_note: Purchase of treasury shares GBP1,377m in FY2025 (FY2025 20-F cash flow statement) and GBP634m in H1 2026, completing the GBP2bn programme in Q2 2026. The flat count is being funded by a repurchaser, but no new programme is authorised and post-Nuvalent leverage makes one unlikely near term.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and balance sheet are in GBP millions. The quote is the NYSE ADS in USD (1 ADS = 2 ordinary shares; shares_outstanding is already in ADS-equivalents). Model-to-quote rate 1.324 USD per GBP (Yahoo GBPUSD=X, regularMarketTime 2026-10-02T21:29Z). Parity check against the LSE primary line: GSK.L closed at 1,779.5p (2026-10-02T15:37Z) x 2 / 100 x 1.324 = US$47.12 per ADS vs the NYSE close of US$47.03, a 0.2% tie that confirms the rate, its direction and the 2:1 ratio. GBP flows are discounted at a GBP WACC and converted at spot; refresh_price.py moves the ADS price but not this rate.
inputs.wacc_rationale: GBP-built, because the flows are GBP. Risk-free ~4.6% (10y gilt), equity beta ~0.70 for large-cap pharma, ERP 5.0% -> cost of equity ~8.1%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~4.7% on GSK's GBP/USD/EUR bond book, ~3.9% after tax. Target weights ~75% equity / 25% debt (market cap ~GBP72bn vs net debt plus contingent consideration ~GBP29bn). WACC ~7.0%. The dolutegravir patent cliff, MFN pricing and M&A execution risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the rate, and WACC is identical across scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: GSK's borrowings and net debt include IFRS-16 lease liabilities (~GBP0.8bn), so lease principal is NOT deducted from the flows. Ongoing lease-asset renewal is charged through the capex path (+0.6pp of revenue, matching FY2025 right-of-use depreciation of GBP206m).
inputs.nci_treatment: ViiV Healthcare is ~78% GSK / 11.7% Pfizer / 10% Shionogi, with preferential dividend rights. NCI is charged ONCE, in the flows: the cash_tax_rate_path is a combined tax-plus-leakage rate of Core tax (17.1% FY2025, ~17.5% guided FY2026, rising with Pillar Two) plus ~4.5pp for the NCI profit share (FY2025 distributions to NCI GBP391m, NCI P&L share GBP555m on Core operating profit of GBP9,783m). Leakage fades ~1pp after the 2028-2030 dolutegravir LoE shrinks ViiV's profit. The balance-sheet NCI (GBP-515m, negative) is not deducted in the bridge. FY0 tie: 9,783 x (1 - 0.22) = GBP7.63bn unlevered, ~GBP7.2bn after ~GBP0.45bn after-tax interest, against Core attributable earnings of ~GBP7.3bn.
inputs.ebitda_basis: Margins are on GSK's CORE basis, rebuilt pre-SBC. FY2025: Core operating profit GBP9,783m (FY2025 20-F core reconciliation) + core D&A GBP1,506m (PPE depreciation 850 + right-of-use depreciation 206 + intangible amortisation 1,258 less the 808 of acquired-intangible amortisation that Core excludes) = Core EBITDA GBP11,289m (34.6%); + SBC 374 = 11,663 (35.7%) pre-SBC. Core excludes restructuring and legal items that recur every year (major restructuring 382/353/109 FY23-25); the base path carries ~0.8pp below the core run-rate for that recurring cash. Core also excludes contingent-consideration (CCL) cash payments to Shionogi (GBP1,277m FY2025) -- those are held as a liability in the bridge instead, so they are charged once.
inputs.capex_basis: FY2025 net capex 8.7% of revenue: PPE 1,348 + intangibles 1,637 - disposals 139 = 2,846. Base path 10.3% = 8.7% + 0.6pp lease renewal + 1.0pp recurring business-development allowance. Intangible purchases (in-licensing, milestones) are kept as capex because they are the recurring cost of refilling the pipeline. The BD allowance exists because the revenue path depends on acquired assets beyond those already paid for (GSK has bought Bellus, Aiolos, IDRx, efimosfermin, RAPT in 2023-26, ~GBP1.2bn/yr ex-Nuvalent); Nuvalent itself is already in pro forma net debt, so its cost is not charged again.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, scenario-weighted, with the non-US adaptations (GBP flows vs USD ADS quote, leases as debt, ViiV NCI in the flows, CCL as a debt-like bridge item). Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md: GSK is an operating pharma/vaccines company whose value is a free-cash-flow stream -- not a bank, REIT, holdco or trust. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY.md entry, no prior DCF). DEMERGER: Consumer Healthcare (Haleon) was demerged July 2022; FY2016-21 consolidated rows include it and are not a base for growth. Historical growth uses RevenueContinuing (FY2020-21 restated continuing 24,354 / 24,696) and FY2022+ figures; FY2022 statutory NI/EPS (GBP14,956m / 366p) include a ~GBP10.5bn demerger gain and are excluded as one-off; FY2022 revenue also carries ~GBP2.3bn of COVID solutions (Xevudy) that did not recur. Pre-2022 share counts (~5.0bn) are on the pre-consolidation basis (4-for-5 share consolidation at the demerger); per-share history before FY2022 is not comparable. FY0 is FY2025 because the component build compounds from a full fiscal year; FY2026 guidance (turnover +3-5% CER, upper half; Core OP +7-9% CER, upper half; Core EPS +7-9%, lower half, on ~GBP800m higher interest including Nuvalent debt; sterling strength ~-2% to turnover and ~-4% to Core OP at AER) sets year 1. H1 2026 AER turnover is +3.5% (16,038 vs 15,502). reported_fcf (OCF 7,741 - capex 2,985) is depressed by GBP1,195m of Zantac settlement payments and GBP1,330m of CCL payments inside OCF; last_fcf follows the house definition (reported_fcf - SBC) and is not the projection base -- the forward build is component-driven from revenue. Price is a regular-session NYSE close, not an after-hours print.

equity_bridge.item: Contingent consideration liabilities (Shionogi-ViiV, Affinivax, Novartis Vaccines, BP Asset IX)
equity_bridge.note: Q2 2026 6-K fair-value table, Level 3, 30 June 2026. Post-tax PV at GSK's 8-9% rates. Debt-like: the Shionogi payments (GBP1,277m FY2025) sit outside Core EBITDA, so the liability is the one place they are charged.
GBP2.1bn cash programme cost announced July 2026, majority in 2026-27 (Q2 2026 6-K); excluded from Core results, so deducted here at approximately its present value.

equity_bridge.item: Other equity investments at fair value (FVTOCI)
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 20-F fair-value hierarchy, 31 December 2025 (592 Level 1 + 196 Level 3). Their income is not in the Core EBITDA path, so the asset is added once here.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026 guidance (turnover +3-5% CER, upper half) and the >GBP40bn 2031 sales outlook (3.4%/yr from FY2025), cross-checked against the continuing-operations revenue 3yr CAGR of 3.7%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR (15.6%) diverges far more than 30% from revenue (3.7%): post-demerger book value restarted from a depressed GBP10.6bn base in FY2022 and is rebuilding mechanically; it is not a growth signal. Equity and EPS 5yr CAGRs cross the Haleon demerger and the 4-for-5 share consolidation and are set to null.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue: RevenueContinuing FY2022 29,324 -> FY2025 32,667 (3yr 3.7%; FY2022 includes ~GBP2.3bn non-recurring COVID solutions, so the underlying rate is closer to 6%); FY2020 continuing 24,354 -> FY2025 (5yr 6.0%). EPS 3yr: FY2022 continuing EPS estimated from continuing profit after tax 4,921 less NCI 637 over ~4,03xm shares (~106p) -> FY2025 138.8p = 9.4%; FY2022 statutory EPS of 366p includes the demerger gain and is excluded. Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC): FY2020 5,821, FY2022 4,799 (still includes H1 Consumer Healthcare), FY2023 4,117, FY2024 3,228, FY2025 4,382. The negative owner-FCF CAGRs are a demerger artefact plus Zantac settlement cash (GBP672m FY2024, GBP1,195m FY2025) and rising CCL payments, not SBC: SBC is a stable ~1.1% of revenue, so the owner-FCF and reported-FCF CAGRs differ only by ~0.4pp.

base.growth_rationale: AER growth. FY2026 3.5% = H1 2026 AER run-rate and guidance upper-half CER less ~2pp sterling drag. FY2027 5.0% on zidesamtinib/neladalkib, depemokimab, Blenrep and Specialty double-digit growth. FY2028-30 slows to 1.5-3% as dolutegravir loses exclusivity (US 2028, EU 2029) against long-acting HIV and oncology growth. Reaches ~GBP39.4bn in FY2031, ~1.5% short of the >GBP40bn outlook as a house haircut, then re-accelerates as management guides.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-SBC Core EBITDA 35.7% FY2025, less ~0.8pp of recurring restructuring/legal cash that Core excludes, plus FY2026 Core OP leverage (OP +7-9% vs sales +3-5% CER). Dips ~0.8pp through the LoE window (management: 'stable to improving', taken slightly below), recovering to 36% as GBP1.9bn of Accelerate Growth savings land and are partly reinvested in R&D.
base.wc_rationale: Negative: a manufacturer with receivables and inventory well above payables; growth consumes ~15% of incremental revenue.

scenario_narratives.base: GSK lands its FY2026 guidance (turnover upper half of +3-5% CER, Core OP upper half of +7-9%) with ~2pp of sterling drag at AER. Specialty Medicines grows low-double-digit on long-acting HIV (Cabenuva, Apretude), Nucala/depemokimab and oncology (Jemperli, Blenrep on its narrow label, Nuvalent's zidesamtinib and neladalkib), Vaccines is broadly flat (Shingrix ex-US penetration offsets Arexvy and US vaccine-policy softness) and General Medicines declines mid-single-digit as Trelegy absorbs Part D redesign. The dolutegravir LoE (US 2028, EU 2029) slows group growth to 1.5-3% for three years and costs ~0.8pp of margin, which Accelerate Growth savings recover. 2031 sales land around GBP39bn against the >GBP40bn outlook. The Shionogi royalty stream, the 2026-27 restructuring cash and the Nuvalent debt are all charged in the bridge.
scenario_narratives.bull: The pipeline does what management says: 15 scale opportunities launch before 2031, ultra-long-acting twice-yearly HIV regimens convert enough of the dolutegravir base before generics bite that HIV barely dips, neladalkib wins ALK first-line share, bepirovirsen (hepatitis B) and depemokimab become multi-billion franchises, and Shingrix ex-US immunisation rates climb from ~12% toward US levels. Sales pass GBP43bn in 2031, Specialty mix and the GBP1.9bn savings lift EBITDA margin toward 38.5%, and MFN/tariff arrangements stay contained to Medicaid. Less BD spending is needed because the internal pipeline fills the gap.
scenario_narratives.bear: The patent cliff bites harder than replacements ramp: dolutegravir generics erode Tivicay/Triumeq/Dovato faster in the US than long-acting injectables can switch patients, Trelegy declines high-single-digit under Part D and channel pricing, US MFN pricing spreads beyond Medicaid after the tariff relief lapses in January 2029, and Arexvy/Shingrix demand weakens under US vaccine-policy shifts. Group sales fall ~5% across 2028-30 and recover only to ~GBP36bn by 2031, well short of GBP40bn; EBITDA margin compresses ~2.5pp as the high-margin HIV pool shrinks while R&D stays elevated. The Nuvalent/RAPT M&A spree under a new CEO needs further bolt-ons (capex 10.8%) to refill the pipeline, and residual Zantac federal MDL exposure stays an overhang.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because GSK's single largest profit pool (dolutegravir) has a dated loss of exclusivity inside the forecast window and US pricing policy (MFN, Part D) is a single-regulator dependency. Bull trimmed from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent pipeline readouts and launches to succeed at once, under a new CEO executing a large M&A and restructuring programme simultaneously. Base at 50% reflects reaffirmed FY2026 guidance and two upgrades in FY2025.

valuation_philosophy.summary: GSK is valued as an unlevered GBP owner-FCF stream on the Core earnings basis, with every cost Core excludes charged exactly once somewhere: SBC and recurring restructuring in the flows, the Shionogi/ViiV contingent consideration and the 2026-27 Accelerate Growth cash in the bridge, ViiV's minority leakage in the tax path, Nuvalent at its cash cost in net debt, and ongoing pipeline business development in capex. The headline question is whether the post-2028 HIV cliff is already in the price; the scenarios are built around that axis rather than around generic growth.
key_risks_to_valuation: Dolutegravir loss of exclusivity (US 2028, EU 2029): the pace of generic erosion vs long-acting conversion is the single largest swing factor
US drug pricing: MFN commitments, IRA Part D redesign and the end of Section 232 tariff relief in January 2029
M&A execution: Nuvalent (GBP8.0bn) and RAPT (GBP1.7bn) must deliver; neladalkib is still under FDA review
Contingent consideration liability to Shionogi is re-measured with ViiV sales forecasts and FX; a stronger HIV outcome raises the liability as well as the flows
Sterling strength: ~-2% to turnover and ~-4% to Core OP at AER on current rates, plus the GBP/USD rate used to translate the value per ADS
Residual Zantac federal MDL litigation not provided for in this bridge
Leverage: pro forma net debt ~GBP22bn plus GBP6.8bn CCL, ~2.5x Core EBITDA including CCL

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for the NYSE ADS at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 42.85-61.70. Parity checked against GSK.L and GBPUSD=X (see inputs.fx_note).
data_sources.financials: GSK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics) and kpis; FY2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F (core reconciliation, free cash flow reconciliation, D&A note, contingent consideration note 32); Q2 2026 results 6-K (net debt analysis, diluted share count, CCL fair value, Nuvalent post-balance-sheet note, FY2026 guidance).
